summary: Bail cancellation appeal; distinction between voluntary extorters vs coerced tax-payers; mens rea prerequisite for UAPA charges; forensic evidence of handwriting; custodial interrogation unwarranted; prima facie case requires intent to further terrorist activity; bail orders reversed improperly by High Court; NIA's prosecution argument of voluntary contribution rejected.
legal_provisions_cited: National Investigation Agency v. Zahoor Ahmad Shah Watali (2019) 5 SCC 1
Ranjitsing Brahhmajeetsing Sharma v. State of Maharashtra and Another (2005) 5 SCC 294
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court's bail cancellation orders set aside; bail granted to appellants restored.
